# WaferScale_Memristor_Integration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Integration of memristive devices at wafer-scale density to form massive, reconfigurable neuromorphic crossbar arrays. Enables high-density, energy-efficient synaptic emulation and in-memory computing, foundational for iNEST's large-scale brain-inspired systems.
